LESSON: ARABIC ALPHABET 1.0 QUR’AN

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we learn the Arabic 1.0 QUR’AN the learner should be able to: Arabic letter sounds. Alphabet?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read simple Arabic words  Organize learners in groups or pairs to for readiness in reciting form and read simple Arabic words the Qur’an  Learners group Arabic letters
2. write Arabic letters for according to their shapes writing readiness from  Learners are guided on how to arrange right to left Arabic alphabet in sequence
3. appreciate proper  Learners practice to write Arabic articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ARABIC ALPHABET 1.0 QUR’AN
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PUT IT TOGETHER

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read simple Arabic words  Organize learners in groups or pairs to for readiness in reciting form and read simple Arabic words the Qur’an  Learners group Arabic letters)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate proper  Learners practice to write Arabic articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read simple Arabic words  Organize learners in groups or pairs to for readiness in reciting form and read simple Arabic words the Qur’an  Learners group Arabic letters.
3. Practise this skill: write Arabic letters for according to their shapes writing readiness from  Learners are guided on how to arrange right to left Arabic alphabet in sequence.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate proper  Learners practice to write Arabic articulation of Qur’an alphabet. recitation.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we learn the Arabic 1.0 QUR’AN the learner should be able to: Arabic letter sounds. Alphabet?
2. How do you pronounce?
3. How do you read?
4. Which letters are in?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read simple Arabic words  Organize learners in groups or pairs to for readiness in reciting form and read simple Arabic words the Qur’an  Learners group Arabic letters.
5. Be able to: write Arabic letters for according to their shapes writing readiness from  Learners are guided on how to arrange right to left Arabic alphabet in sequence.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
